title: ProxyGenBench: Benchmarking Proxy-Guided Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.34457v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent video generators produce realistic videos, yet controlling how scenes unfold remains challenging. Structural proxies, such as animated 3D blockouts, guide generation by specifying scene layout, motion, camera behavior, and event order. However, these coarse inputs leave details unspecified and may contain artifacts that should not be reproduced. Successful proxy-guided generation must therefore Preserve intended structure, Complete missing content and correct proxy artifacts, and Bind text, image, and audio conditions to the right entities and events. We introduce ProxyGenBench to study these interacting requirements, with 312 evaluation cases from 60 scenes across three scene tasks and controlled variations in proxy fidelity, text detail, and multimodal inputs. translated_title: ProxyGenBench：代理引导视频生成的基准测试
translated_abstract: 近期视频生成器能够产出逼真的视频，但如何控制场景的展开过程仍然是一个难题。结构性代理（如可动画的3D粗模）通过指定场景布局、运动、相机行为和事件顺序来引导生成。然而，这类粗糙输入会留下未指明的细节，且可能包含不应被复现的瑕疵。因此，成功的代理引导生成必须做到：保留预期的结构、补全缺失内容并纠正代理瑕疵、以及将文本、图像和音频条件正确绑定到对应的实体与事件。我们提出ProxyGenBench来研究这些相互交织的要求，该基准包含来自60个场景、覆盖三类场景任务的312个评估案例，并对代理保真度、文本细节和多模态输入进行了可控变化。我们使用经过验证的、针对具体案例的检查清单评估了五个视频生成器。实验表明，代理能够提升时空控制能力，但更精细的代理细节可能会……
tldr: 提出ProxyGenBench基准，通过312个案例系统评估代理引导视频生成器在结构保留、内容补全和多模态条件绑定方面的能力，发现代理虽提升时空控制，但代理细节与生成质量之间可能存在冲突。
en_tdlr: ProxyGenBench introduces 312 controlled evaluation cases to systematically benchmark proxy-guided video generators on preserving intended structure, completing missing content, and binding multimodal conditions, revealing that while proxies improve spatiotemporal control, finer proxy detail can conflict with generation quality.
